## Docker Hub Description

A self-hosted Markdown workspace. Edit real files in your browser. Your files stay yours.

Character count: **89** (including spaces and punctuation; limit: 100).

## Docker Hub Categories

- **Content management system** — closest available category for file-based content editing and organization; this does not imply blog publishing.
- **Developer tools** — project documentation and Markdown instruction files are supported use cases.

Docker Hub accepts up to three categories. These names and the description limit were checked against [Docker's repository-information documentation](https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/repos/manage/information/).
